subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Which block-streaming boundary contract should OpenClaw require before landing one of the open candidate fixes for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but the candidate fixes and current delivery-limit docs show maintainers must choose how paragraph boundaries survive flushes without over-limit chunks or doubled separators.

options.title: Consolidate a complete shared fix
options.body: Pick one candidate or replacement and require preservation across both normal and maxChars-adjacent paragraph splits before merge.

options.title: Carry explicit seam metadata
options.body: Ask contributors to represent paragraph/newline/hard-split boundaries through the pipeline if text-only chunks cannot satisfy the invariant cleanly.

options.title: Accept a partial text repair
options.body: Maintainership can intentionally land a common-case separator fix while leaving edge boundaries tracked on this issue.

recommendation.title: Consolidate a complete shared fix
recommendation.body: Pick one candidate or replacement and require preservation across both normal and maxChars-adjacent paragraph splits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate for the affected chunker/coalescer surfaces and the maintainer-level contract choice.
